A field guide to an inhabited world · volume XIX · the plant family

Flora

Five plant monster girls: the alraune in her great flower, the matango of the mushroom fields, the towering ent, the prickly cactus and the little mandragora who screams when pulled out of the ground. Slow, patient and alive with the seasons.

Favourite food: Bone meal (and a water bottle)

The central similarity

Rooted.

Plant girls do not wander far. They root where the soil suits them and make the land around them bloom.

  • RootedThey move slowly or not at all; the matango travels through mycelium.
  • GrowthCrops and saplings near a happy plant girl grow faster.
  • SunlightThey heal in sunlight and with water; darkness makes them sluggish.
  • Bone mealThe family food: bone meal (and a water bottle).

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a flora builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Bone meal (+2), water bottles (+1)
  • Planting flowers and saplings near her (+1)

What costs trust

  • Axes and fire
  • Trampling her flowers

Devoted (60+)

She makes your farm grow (crops near her grow much faster) and brings seeds, saplings and flowers.

Mating & young

FormA seed. YoungA seedling girl, grown in 5 days. WherePlanted in soil. Seedlings use the adult model at 45%.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may share your bed (she plants herself beside it).
2. SeedsShe drops a seed (a girl egg) into the soil.
3. SproutingAfter a day it sprouts into a seedling girl.
4. GrownGrown in five days, devoted to her father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

RootingStanding still on dirt or grass, she roots: regenerates and makes crops within 6 blocks grow.
PollenThe alraune puffs pollen at attackers (Nausea, Slowness).
Mycelium travelThe matango sinks into mycelium or podzol and rises elsewhere nearby; her spores make attackers sick.
EntThe ent is huge and slow, plants saplings and hits very hard.
ThornsThe cactus hurts whatever hits her.
ScreamPulled from the ground (right-click while she hides), the mandragora screams: everyone nearby but you is stunned.

Species profiles

Flower forests & meadowsSweet · alluring

Alraune (about 1.8 blocks)

TemperamentSweet, alluring, patient

Ecology & behaviourHer upper body rises from the heart of a great flower; vines and petals are her lower body.

Signature: PollenAttackers are dusted with pollen (Nausea and Slowness). She barely moves, and flowers spring up around her.

Player interactionBone meal and a little water.

Mushroom fields & dark forestsDrowsy · odd

Matango (about 1.6 blocks)

TemperamentDrowsy, odd, gentle

Ecology & behaviourCovered in mushrooms, with a cap for a hat. Below the waist she fades into a carpet of mycelium.

Signature: Mycelium travelShe sinks into mycelium or podzol and rises again nearby. Her spores make attackers sick (Nausea, Poison).

Player interactionBone meal; let her drift.

Colour variants

Spawns inmushroom_fields, dark_forest

Old-growth forestsHuge · gentle

Ent (about 3.2 blocks)

TemperamentSlow, gentle, ancient

Ecology & behaviourA living tree as tall as a house, with a kind face in the bark and a crown of leaves.

Signature: PlanterShe plants saplings as she walks and hits extremely hard. Axes and fire anger her.

Player interactionPlant saplings with her.

Deserts & badlandsPrickly · resilient

Cactus (about 1.9 blocks)

TemperamentPrickly on the outside, sweet inside

Ecology & behaviourA tall green girl covered in spines, with a flower in her hair. She needs almost no water.

Signature: ThornsAnything that hits her is hurt by her spines. She blooms when happy (a flower present).

Player interactionA water bottle is a luxury to her.

Mandragora (about 1.0 blocks)

TemperamentShy, sulky, very loud

Ecology & behaviourA little root girl who spends most of her life buried, with only her leaves showing.

Signature: ScreamShe hides in the ground with only her leaves showing. Pulled out, she screams: mobs nearby (not you) are stunned (Slowness IV, Nausea).

Player interactionPull her out (and cover your ears), then give her bone meal.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Rooted (still on soil): heals and grows crops nearby (much faster when devoted)
  • Bone meal and water
  • Alraune: pollen (Nausea, Slowness), plants flowers
  • Matango: spores, sinks into the ground and comes up elsewhere
  • Ent: plants saplings, hits very hard
  • Cactus: spines hurt attackers
  • Mandragora: buries herself, screams when pulled out (stuns all but the puller)
  • Fire hurts double
  • Seeds that sprout into seedlings

Not yet

  • Plantable alraune flower block

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • The user listed three plants; the cactus and the mandragora were added to reach five.

Open questions
